subject: SIG cadence, demo slot & evidence ownership playbook
body:
From: Carla Vazquez <carla.vazquez@cypherworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: SIG intake - initial availability and contacts

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — we got your intake form and want to move forward. We're aiming to get SIG/CAIQ coverage and a short demo of how log exports and residency controls work in your Dedicated offering. A few notes from our side:
- We have a small security team (see attached contacts).
- Preferred kickoff window: Nov 23–24 (PST mornings) or Nov 30 (any time).
- We will need log sampling instructions and a brief template for the evidence items we'll share.

I've attached the contacts CSV and a short note 'sample-logs-request.txt' with our initial ask. Please loop in whoever owns artifacts.

Best,
Carla Vazquez
Head of Security, CypherWorks
security@cypherworks.com

[Attachment: cypher_poc_contacts.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: sample-logs-request.txt (text/plain)]

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Carla Vazquez <carla.vazquez@cypherworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake - proposed cadence and owners

Carla — great, thank you. Looping in Marissa (security intake lead) and Ben (SE for demos).

Proposed plan:
1) 30–45 min kickoff to align scope (SIG vs CAIQ overlap) + confirm evidence list.
2) 45 min demo (logs export, residency controls, sample retention) for ops folks.
3) Follow-up sprint: evidence drop window + Q&A asynchronously (we'll consolidate).

Availability I can offer: Nov 24 09:00–11:00 PST (kickoff), Nov 30 any time for demo. Marissa — can you own the intake matrix and the initial artifact mapping? Ben — can you plan a 20–30 min demo flow showing retention and log download?

Action items:
- Marissa to publish intake matrix and assign owners.
- CypherWorks to confirm kickoff slot and provide any additional SMEs.
- Rishi to send HubSpot link and Drive upload location.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0189

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>; Carla Vazquez <carla.vazquez@cypherworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake - intake matrix & artifact owners (draft)

Hi Carla — thanks for the contacts and sample request. I've drafted an intake matrix and broken the evidence down into three buckets: People, Process, Technical.

Quick summary (draft):
- People: IAM owners, admin list, SSO provider screenshots (owner: CypherWorks security).
- Process: Change control, incident response runbook (owner: CypherWorks ops).
- Technical: Logging samples, access logs, config snapshots (owner: Redwood: Marissa for collection; Ben for demo/exports).

Proposed kickoff agenda (30–40m):
- Introductions (5m)
- Scope confirmation: SIG vs CAIQ fields to prioritize (10m)
- Evidence owners & upload process (10m)
- Demo timing/ask for logs export (10m)

Upload & links:
- Please upload artifacts to this folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/cypher-sig-artifacts
- HubSpot record for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Slots I can take for kickoff (PST):
- Tue Nov 23 09:30–10:15
- Wed Nov 24 09:00–09:45
- Mon Nov 29 11:00–11:45

Ben will cover the demo portion on Nov 30 if that works for larger ops audience. I'm attaching the intake matrix (CSV stub below) and a short sample-logs checklist.

Attachment stubs:
- [Attachment: intake-matrix-cypher.csv (text/csv)]
- [Attachment: logs-checklist.md (text/markdown)]

Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---
From: Carla Vazquez <carla.vazquez@cypherworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cypherworks.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake - intake matrix & artifact owners (draft)

Thanks — Wed Nov 24 09:00 PST works for us for the kickoff. We confirmed internal SMEs: 
- Miguel Torres (platform ops)
- Jenna Park (identity)

We will start uploading the SSO screenshots and change-control doc to the Drive folder today. Miguel will attach a small set of logs for the demo team to review (see sample-logs-request.txt).

One ask: Can you provide a short 'how-to' for exporting the 24-hour log slice? We'll need steps and expected file formats. Also confirm whether redwood provides a signed attest for configuration snapshots.

Carla

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Carla Vazquez <carla.vazquez@cypherworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG intake - intake matrix & artifact owners (draft)

Carla — confirmed for Nov 24 09:00 PST kickoff and I'll run the Nov 30 demo. A few notes ahead of time:

- 24-hour log export: we'll demonstrate two export options — streaming export (S3) and ad-hoc CSV slice. Expected filename patterns and sizes will be shared on the call.
- Signed config snapshots: Redwood can provide config export artifacts; for a signed attest you can use our compliance package add-on (I can loop in Customer Success if you'd like a quote).
- I'll upload a short 'how-to' doc before the kickoff to the Drive link.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
[Attachment: demo-outline.pdf (application/pdf) — stub]
